security_level.words: The security grain exists in the custodian position silver that the producer declares in sources.json (the entry that carries positions_prefix): dim_position, one row per account and security per day. Its 2026-04-20 and 2026-04-21 partitions were read with the six declared columns. Pairs are the (account, security) pairs of the GRADED_DISAGREED accounts held with positive quantity on both days; the security is the cusip, else the ticker. Classes by precedence: absent (no closing price on 2026-04-21), stale (secprice_lstupdte before 2026-04-21), flat (closing price equal to the previous day's), moved (the rest). The custodian position source carries no security class: no class table was read, as the order grants no such read, so the class is the words not carried by this source. Of 13968 pairs, 38 are flagged (32 flat, 6 stale, 0 absent) and 13930 moved; 15 (security, class) entries are listed, most affected first.

source.table: dim_position, custodian position silver, partitions date=2026-04-20 and date=2026-04-21
source.words: bucket and positions_prefix read from the declared entry; exactly two partitions read; no other prefix of the source touched

return_triangle.words: The custodian positions side with the guard's holdings input: for 894 of the 929 accounts the position-based return agrees with the holdings gold price return within the 2026-04-21 tolerance, and for none does it agree with the account value return; 35 agree with neither. The triangle is computed from the pairs priced on both days and held on the previous day, weighted by the previous day's quantity.

positive_control.description: four synthetic pairs through the pair classifier (a flat price, an absent price, a stale secprice_lstupdte, a moved price) and one synthetic account through the return triangle (R_pos -0.02 against a holdings return of -0.02 and an account value return of -0.1, tolerance 0.001244)

method_words: Read the round 118 flow-guard record for its first date (2026-04-21): VALUE 941 plus FLOW_AND_VALUE 2 gives value_rows 943. Read the IRPT_BCKEND gold of the 49 Financial firm, addressed by lib opal_naming address(): the account_return_daily partitions of 2026-04-20 and 2026-04-21, the 2026-04-21 manifest for the tolerance, and the holdings_performance_daily partition of 2026-04-21, with six GET calls and no other gold read. Read bucket and positions_prefix from the one entry of sources.json that carries positions_prefix, then exactly two custodian dim_position partitions (2026-04-20 and 2026-04-21) with six columns each. Profiled the GRADED_DISAGREED accounts against the holdings partition: 943 accounts, every one holds a holdings row, every holdings status is OK, excluded_count is zero for 937 and above zero for 6, and excluded_weight is zero or null for all 943. Security grain: 13968 pairs held on both days by these accounts, 38 flagged (32 flat, 6 stale, none absent), 13930 moved; the custodian positions side with the holdings gold return for 894 of 929 accounts and with the account value for none. In one paragraph: for the 943 accounts the holdings gold reports status OK and a zero or null excluded weight, so the excluded-security channel does not explain the cohort; the custodian positions show that almost every held security priced on 2026-04-21 moved, so the holdings price return the guard compares against agrees with the position prices and the account value does not; the account value return, not the price, is the input that moved away from the positions. The class of each security is not carried by the custodian source and is recorded as absent.
